com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFPingMyPhoneIn.name: Ping My iPhone
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFPingMyPhoneIn.description:
Plays a sound on your paired iPhone.

You can also choose to have the flashlight pulse.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetAlwaysOnIn.name: Set Always On
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetAlwaysOnIn.description:
Sets the Always On display setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Always On is activated, your Apple Watch face will be visible even when your wrist is down.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetAutoLaunch.name: Set Auto-Launch Audio Apps
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetAutoLaunch.description:
Sets the Auto-Launch Audio Apps setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Auto-Launch Audio Apps is on, the app actively playing media will be shown when your Apple Watch wakes.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetSchoolTime.name: Set Schooltime
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetSchoolTime.description:
Sets Schooltime on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Schooltime limits Apple Watch features during school hours.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetSilentMode.name: Set Silent Mode
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetSilentMode.description:
Sets Silent Mode on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Silent Mode mutes most Apple Watch sounds.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetTheaterMod.name: Set Theater Mode
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetTheaterMod.description:
Sets Theater Mode on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Theater Mode mutes most Apple Watch sounds and limits display activity.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetWakeOnWris.name: Set Wake on Wrist Raise
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetWakeOnWris.description:
Sets the Wake on Wrist Raise setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Wake on Wrist Raise is on, the screen will wake when you raise your wrist.

com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetWaterLockI.name: Set Water Lock
com.apple.NanoSettings.NPRFSetWaterLockI.description:
Sets the Water Lock setting on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Water Lock protects against accidental input when you use your Apple Watch in water.

com.apple.Notes.ICNotesFolderIntent.name: Show Notes Folder
com.apple.Notes.ICNotesFolderIntent.description: Get quick access to one of your Notes folders.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Change Background Sound
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Change the background sound that will play when background sounds is turned on. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Background Sounds Timer Interval
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Sets the timer interval for background sounds. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise and can be used when media is playing. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Background Sounds Volume
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Sets the volume for background sounds.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Accessibility Keyboard
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable the Accessibility Keyboard, allowing typing by clicking on the screen.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Alternate Pointer Actions
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Alternate Pointer Actions, allowing the use of switches or gesture to trigger mouse actions such as clicks.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Audio Descriptions
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Automatically play audio descriptions. Audio Descriptions can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Toggle Background Sounds
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Background Sounds.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Closed Captions+SDH
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Use closed captions for the deaf and hard of hearing. Closed captions can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Classic Invert
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Reverses the colors of the display. Classic Invert can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Color Filters
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Color Filters, allowing the display's colors to be adjusted as desired.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Increase Contrast
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Increase color contrast between app foreground and background colors. Increase Contrast can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Full Keyboard Access
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Full Keyboard Access, allowing use of the device with only a keyboard.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Head Pointer
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Head Pointer, allowing movement of the mouse cursor using your head.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Hover Text
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Hover Text.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Hover Typing
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Hover Typing.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Live Captions
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Live Captions.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Live Speech
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Live Speech.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Mono Audio
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Mono Audio enables the left and right speakers to play the same content. Mono Audio can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Motion Cues
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Motion Cues.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Mouse Keys
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Mouse Keys, allowing the movement of the mouse cursor using the keyboard.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Reduce Motion
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Reduce the motion of the user interface, including the parallax effect of icons. Reduce Motion can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Slow Keys
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Slow Keys, allowing the keyboard to avoid recognizing rapid key presses.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Smart Invert
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Reverses the colors of the display except for images, media and some apps that use dark color styles. Smart Invert can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Sticky Keys
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Enable or disable Sticky Keys, making it easier to press keyboard modifier keys.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Switch Control
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Switch Control highlights items on the screen to control through an adaptive accessory. Switch Control can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Reduce Transparency
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Improve contrast by reducing transparency and blurs on some backgrounds to increase legibility. Reduce Transparency can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Voice Control
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Voice Control allows you to use your voice to control your iOS device. Voice Control can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set VoiceOver
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: VoiceOver speaks items on the screen. VoiceOver can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.name: Set Zoom
com.apple.UniversalAccess.UASettingsShor.description: Zoom magnifies the entire screen. Zoom can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

com.apple.facetime.facetime.name: FaceTime
com.apple.facetime.facetime.description: Calls the contact passed in as input using FaceTime.

com.apple.iWork.Numbers.TNiOSOpenAnyDocu.description: Open the specified spreadsheet in Numbers.

com.apple.iWork.Numbers.TSADocumentCreat.description: Create a new spreadsheet from a template.

com.apple.iWork.Pages.TPDocumentBeginPre.description: Open the Pages document in presenter mode.

com.apple.iWork.Pages.TSADocumentCreateI.description: Create a new document from a template.

com.apple.iWork.Pages.TSADocumentOpenInt.description: Open the specified document in Pages.

com.apple.mobilephone.call.description: Calls the phone number passed in as input.

com.apple.musicrecognition.RecognizeMusi.description: Uses the microphone to listen to and identify nearby media.

com.apple.news.TagIntent.name: Show Topic
com.apple.news.TagIntent.description: Shows stories about the topic you choose.

com.apple.news.TodayIntent.name: Show Today Feed
com.apple.news.TodayIntent.description: Shows stories from the Today feed in Apple News.

com.apple.weather.WeatherIntent.name: Show Weather
com.apple.weather.WeatherIntent.description: Shows and gets the current weather for the specified location.

is.workflow.actions.addframetogif.name: Add Frame to GIF
is.workflow.actions.addframetogif.description: Adds an image to the existing animated GIF passed as input. If no GIF is passed as input, a new animated GIF is created.

is.workflow.actions.additemtolist.name: Add Item to List
is.workflow.actions.additemtolist.description: Adds the specified item to a list at the beginning, end, or a specific index.
is.workflow.actions.additemtolist.descriptionNote: Lists use one-based indexing, so the first item is at index 1, the second is at index 2, etc.

is.workflow.actions.addmusictoupnext.name: Add to Playing Next
is.workflow.actions.addmusictoupnext.description: Adds the music passed as input to your Playing Next queue.

is.workflow.actions.addnewcalendar.name: Add New Calendar
is.workflow.actions.addnewcalendar.descriptionResult: The name of the new calendar

WFContactFirstName.label: First name
WFContactFirstName.description: The first name of the contact.

WFContactLastName.label: Last name
WFContactLastName.description: The last name of the contact.

is.workflow.actions.addnewevent.name: New Event
is.workflow.actions.addnewevent.description: Creates a new event and adds it to the selected calendar.

WFCalendarDescriptor.label: Calendar
WFCalendarDescriptor.description: The calendar to add this event to.

WFCalendarItemStartDate.label: Start Date
WFCalendarItemStartDate.description: Text representing the date this event begins. Examples: “tomorrow at 2”, “January 3”, “8:00pm”

WFCalendarItemEndDate.label: End Date
WFCalendarItemEndDate.description: Text representing the date this event finishes.

WFCalendarItemAllDay.label: All Day
WFCalendarItemAllDay.description: When enabled, the event takes place over an entire day and time is ignored.

WFAlertTime.label: Alert
WFAlertTime.description: Optionally, when to show an alert to notify me of this event.

WFAlertCustomTime.label: Alert Time
WFAlertCustomTime.description: Text representing the date when the alert should occur. Examples: “tonight at 7”, “March 7”

WFCalendarItemNotes.label: Notes
WFCalendarItemNotes.description: Optionally, a description for this event.

is.workflow.actions.addnewreminder.name: New Reminder
is.workflow.actions.addnewreminder.description: Creates a new reminder and adds it to the selected list of reminders.

WFCalendarDescriptor.label: List
WFCalendarDescriptor.description: The list of reminders to add this reminder to.

WFAlertLocation.label: Location
WFAlertLocation.description: The location that triggers the alert.

WFAlertPerson.label: Person
WFAlertPerson.description: The reminder notification will be shown when chatting with this person in Messages.

WFAlertLocationRadius.label: Radius
WFAlertLocationRadius.description: The distance from the provided location to consider “arriving” or “leaving” the location

WFAlertCustomTime.label: Time
WFAlertCustomTime.description: Text representing the date or date and time when the alert should occur. Examples: “tonight at 7”, “March 7”

WFURL.label: URL
WFURL.description: Optionally, a URL to attach to this reminder.

WFImages.label: Images
WFImages.description: An optional set of images to attach to this reminder. Use a variable to get the images.

WFParentTask.label: Parent Reminder
WFParentTask.description: Optionally, a parent reminder to add this reminder to.

WFTags.label: Tags
WFTags.description: Optionally, tags to add to this reminder.

WFCalendarItemNotes.label: Notes
WFCalendarItemNotes.description: Optionally, a description for this reminder.

is.workflow.actions.address.name: Street Address
is.workflow.actions.address.description: Passes the specified address to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.addtoplaylist.name: Add to Playlist
is.workflow.actions.addtoplaylist.description: Adds the items passed as input to the specified playlist.
is.workflow.actions.addtoplaylist.descriptionResult: The contents of the updated playlist

is.workflow.actions.adjustdate.name: Adjust Date
is.workflow.actions.adjustdate.description: Adds or subtracts an amount of time from the date passed into the action.
is.workflow.actions.adjustdate.descriptionNote: This action supports decimal numbers when adding or subtracting seconds, minutes, hours, or days. Otherwise only integers are supported.

is.workflow.actions.airdropdocument.name: AirDrop
is.workflow.actions.airdropdocument.description: Prompts to share the specified content via AirDrop.

is.workflow.actions.airplanemode.set.name: Set Airplane Mode
is.workflow.actions.airplanemode.set.description: Sets the device’s Airplane Mode to on or off.

is.workflow.actions.alert.name: Show Alert
is.workflow.actions.alert.description: Displays an alert with a title, a message, and two buttons. If the user selects the OK button, the shortcut continues. The cancel button stops the shortcut.

is.workflow.actions.announcenotification.name: Set Announce Notifications
is.workflow.actions.announcenotification.description: Sets Announce Notifications to on or off. When on, Siri will announce notifications from new apps that send Time Sensitive notifications or direct messages.

is.workflow.actions.appendvariable.name: Add to Variable
is.workflow.actions.appendvariable.description: Appends this action’s input to the specified variable, creating the variable if it does not exist.\n\nThis allows you to make a variable hold multiple items.
is.workflow.actions.appendvariable.descriptionResult: The updated contents of the variable.

is.workflow.actions.ask.name: Ask for Input
is.workflow.actions.ask.description: Displays a dialog prompting the user to enter a piece of information.

is.workflow.actions.askllm.name: Use Model
is.workflow.actions.askllm.description: Use a model to handle complex requests in your shortcuts.

WFLLMPrompt.label: Request
WFLLMPrompt.description: A request for the model that optionally includes variables and outputs from previous actions, including calendar events, reminders, images, and more.

WFAllowWebSearch.label: Use Broad World Knowledge
WFAllowWebSearch.description: Allow the model to go out to the web for up-to-date information.

WFGenerativeResultType.label: Output
WFGenerativeResultType.description: Responses are automatically optimized for the actions they’re passed into — for example, if the response is passed into the ‘Repeat with Each’ action, the model creates a list.\n\nTo manually specify the model’s output, select an output type using the ‘Output’ parameter.

FollowUp.label: Follow Up
FollowUp.description:
Show the model’s response and make additional requests before the final response is passed to the next action.

**Private Cloud Compute Models**
Use large server-based models on Private Cloud Compute to handle complex requests while protecting your privacy.

**On-Device Model**
Use the on-device model to handle simple requests without the need for a network connection.

Image analysis is supported by the Private Cloud Compute and Extension models, however image generation is not supported.

is.workflow.actions.avairyeditphoto.name: Markup
is.workflow.actions.avairyeditphoto.description: Edits an image or PDF with Markup.

is.workflow.actions.base64encode.name: Base64 Encode
is.workflow.actions.base64encode.description: Encodes or decodes text or files using Base64 encoding.

is.workflow.actions.bluetooth.set.name: Set Bluetooth
is.workflow.actions.bluetooth.set.description: Sets the device’s Bluetooth to on or off.

is.workflow.actions.calculateexpression.name: Calculate Expression
is.workflow.actions.calculateexpression.description:
Evaluates the mathematical expression in the given input text and outputs the result as a number. 

Example expressions:

7 + 7

8 * sqrt(5)

$8 USD in euros

7 feet in meters

is.workflow.actions.cellulardata.set.name: Set Cellular Data
is.workflow.actions.cellulardata.set.description: Sets the device’s Cellular Data to on or off.

is.workflow.actions.choosefromlist.name: Choose from List
is.workflow.actions.choosefromlist.description: Presents a menu of the items passed as input to the action and outputs the user’s selection.

WFChooseFromListActionPrompt.label: Prompt
WFChooseFromListActionPrompt.description: The instruction provided when the list is presented.

WFChooseFromListActionSelectMultiple.label: Select Multiple
WFChooseFromListActionSelectMultiple.description: When enabled, multiple items may be chosen from the list.

WFChooseFromListActionSelectAll.label: Select All Initially
WFChooseFromListActionSelectAll.description: When enabled, all of the items in the list will start out selected when Choose from List is presented.

is.workflow.actions.choosefrommenu.name: Choose from Menu
is.workflow.actions.choosefrommenu.description: Presents a menu and runs different actions based on which menu item was chosen.

WFMenuPrompt.label: Prompt
WFMenuPrompt.description: The instruction provided when the menu is presented.

is.workflow.actions.clearupnext.name: Clear Playing Next
is.workflow.actions.clearupnext.description: Clears all the music in your Playing Next queue.

is.workflow.actions.cloudapp.upload.name: Upload to CloudApp
is.workflow.actions.cloudapp.upload.description: Uploads the input to CloudApp and returns the CloudApp URL.

is.workflow.actions.comment.name: Comment
is.workflow.actions.comment.description: This action lets you explain how part of a shortcut works. When run, this action does nothing.

is.workflow.actions.compresspdf.name: Optimize File Size of PDF
is.workflow.actions.compresspdf.description: Optimizes the file size of the provided PDF file by compressing its images.\n\nIf the images contained in the PDF are already compressed, this action might not have a measurable effect on file size.

is.workflow.actions.conditional.name: If
is.workflow.actions.conditional.description: Tests if a condition is true, and if so, runs the actions inside. Otherwise, the actions under “Otherwise” are run.

is.workflow.actions.connecttoservers.name: Connect to Servers
is.workflow.actions.connecttoservers.description: Connects your computer to the specified file servers on the network. For example, you can connect to SMB/CIFS, NFS, FTP (read-only), or WebDAV servers.

is.workflow.actions.contacts.name: Contacts
is.workflow.actions.contacts.description: Passes the specified contacts to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.converttimezone.name: Convert Time Zone
is.workflow.actions.converttimezone.description: Converts the specified date and time from one time zone to another.

is.workflow.actions.correctspelling.name: Correct Spelling
is.workflow.actions.correctspelling.description: Autocorrects the spelling of text passed into the action.

is.workflow.actions.count.name: Count
is.workflow.actions.count.description: Counts the number of items, characters, words, sentences, or lines passed as input.
is.workflow.actions.count.descriptionNote: This is just like the Count in Sesame Street, but instead of a vampire, it’s a Shortcuts action.

is.workflow.actions.createplaylist.name: Create Playlist
is.workflow.actions.createplaylist.description: Creates a new playlist in the Music app, adding any items passed as input to the new playlist.

is.workflow.actions.date.name: Date
is.workflow.actions.date.description: Passes the specified date and time to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.debug.contentattribu.name: Show Content Attribution
is.workflow.actions.debug.contentattribu.description: Shows the Content Source of Input contents

is.workflow.actions.delay.name: Wait
is.workflow.actions.delay.description: Waits for the specified number of seconds before continuing with the next action.

is.workflow.actions.deletestoredcontent.name: Delete Stored Content
is.workflow.actions.deletestoredcontent.description: Deletes stored content for the specified name.

WFStoredContentGlobalValue.label: Global Value
WFStoredContentGlobalValue.description: When enabled, any shortcut on your device can access and update this stored value. Otherwise, the value is only accessible within this shortcut.

is.workflow.actions.deskconnect.send.name: Send via DeskConnect
is.workflow.actions.deskconnect.send.description: Sends the input to another device via DeskConnect. DeskConnect makes it easy to send web pages, documents, pictures, and anything else between your devices.
is.workflow.actions.deskconnect.send.summary: Send ${WFInput} via the missing link between your devices, DeskConnect 💔

is.workflow.actions.detect.address.name: Get Addresses from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.address.description: Returns any street addresses found in the output from the previous action.

is.workflow.actions.detect.contacts.name: Get Contacts from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.contacts.description: Gets contacts from the result of the previous action.

is.workflow.actions.detect.date.name: Get Dates from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.date.description: Returns any dates found in the output from the previous action.

is.workflow.actions.detect.dictionary.name: Get Dictionary from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.dictionary.description: Makes a dictionary from the text passed as input. JSON (like {\"foo\": \"bar\"}), key-value pairs (like foo=bar&baz=biz), and XML-based plist are supported.

is.workflow.actions.detect.emailaddress.name: Get Email Addresses from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.emailaddress.description: Returns any email addresses found in the output from the previous action.

is.workflow.actions.detect.images.name: Get Images from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.images.description: Gets images from the result of the previous action.\n\nFor example, this action can get the album art of a song, or all the images on a web page.

is.workflow.actions.detect.link.name: Get URLs from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.link.description: Returns any links found in the output from the previous action.

is.workflow.actions.detect.number.name: Get Numbers from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.number.description: Returns numbers from the previous action’s output.

is.workflow.actions.detect.phonenumber.name: Get Phone Numbers from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.phonenumber.description: Returns any phone numbers found in the output from the previous action.

is.workflow.actions.detect.text.name: Get Text from Input
is.workflow.actions.detect.text.description: Returns text from the previous action’s output.\n\nFor example, this action can get the name of a photo or song, or the text of a web page.

is.workflow.actions.detectlanguage.name: Detect Language
is.workflow.actions.detectlanguage.description: Detects the language of the text provided as input.

is.workflow.actions.dictatetext.name: Dictate Text
is.workflow.actions.dictatetext.description: Transcribes what you say aloud into text and passes the result to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.dictionary.name: Dictionary
is.workflow.actions.dictionary.description: Passes the specified list of key-value pairs to the next action as a dictionary.
is.workflow.actions.dictionary.descriptionNote: When coerced to text, the dictionary is represented as JSON.

is.workflow.actions.dismisssiri.name: Dismiss Siri and Continue
is.workflow.actions.dismisssiri.description: Switches into the Shortcuts app and continues to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.display.always-on.se.name: Set Always On Display
is.workflow.actions.display.always-on.se.description: Sets the Always On Display setting of your iPhone to on or off.

is.workflow.actions.displaysleep.name: Put Display to Sleep
is.workflow.actions.displaysleep.description: Puts the display(s) of this Mac to sleep.

is.workflow.actions.dnd.getfocus.name: Get Current Focus
is.workflow.actions.dnd.getfocus.descriptionNote: This action returns nothing if no Focus is active.

is.workflow.actions.dnd.set.name: Set Focus
is.workflow.actions.dnd.set.description: Sets the specified Focus on or off.

Event.label: Event
Event.description: The event after which to turn off the Focus

Time.label: Time
Time.description: The time after which to turn off the Focus

is.workflow.actions.documentpicker.open.name: Get File from Folder
is.workflow.actions.documentpicker.open.description: Gets a file or folder by a relative path, starting at a folder you choose.

WFGetFilePath.label: Path
WFGetFilePath.description: The relative path to retrieve, such as “folder/file.txt”

is.workflow.actions.documentpicker.save.name: Save File
is.workflow.actions.documentpicker.save.description: Saves files to a specified folder. You can also use this action to copy a file.

WFFileDestinationPath.label: Subpath
WFFileDestinationPath.description: The path to save to, such as “/folder/file.txt”

is.workflow.actions.downloadurl.name: Get Contents of URL
is.workflow.actions.downloadurl.description: Gets the contents of URLs passed into the action. Useful for downloading files and web content, or for making API requests.
is.workflow.actions.downloadurl.descriptionNote: To make a multipart HTTP request, choose “Form” as the request body type and add files as field values.

is.workflow.actions.dropbox.appendfile.name: Append to Dropbox Text File
is.workflow.actions.dropbox.appendfile.description: Adds the text passed as input to the end of the specified file.
is.workflow.actions.dropbox.appendfile.descriptionNote: If no file exists yet at the specified path, a new file will be created. Make sure to include a file extension (usually .txt) at the end of your path.

is.workflow.actions.homeaccessory.description: Set the state of your home.

is.workflow.actions.image.combine.name: Combine Images
is.workflow.actions.image.combine.description: Combines the images passed into the action horizontally, vertically, or in a grid.

WFImageCombineSpacing.label: Spacing
WFImageCombineSpacing.description: The number of pixels of transparent space to place between consecutive images.

is.workflow.actions.image.convert.name: Convert Image
is.workflow.actions.image.convert.description: Converts the images passed into the action to the specified image format.

WFImageCompressionQuality.label: Quality
WFImageCompressionQuality.description: Allows you to choose the image quality used when compressing the image file. Higher quality images will look better, but result in larger files.

WFImagePreserveMetadata.label: Preserve Metadata
WFImagePreserveMetadata.description: When Preserve Metadata is turned off, all metadata, such as the GPS coordinates where the photo was taken, will be stripped from the image file.

is.workflow.actions.image.crop.name: Crop Image
is.workflow.actions.image.crop.description: Crops images to a smaller rectangle.

WFImageCropPosition.label: Position
WFImageCropPosition.description: Where on the original image the crop should occur.

is.workflow.actions.image.flip.name: Flip Image
is.workflow.actions.image.flip.description: Reverses the direction of images either horizontally or vertically.

is.workflow.actions.image.mask.name: Mask Image
is.workflow.actions.image.mask.description: Applies a mask to each image passed into the action. For example, you can cut images into a rounded rectangle, ellipse or icon shape, or provide a custom alpha mask.

WFMaskCornerRadius.label: Corner Radius
WFMaskCornerRadius.description: A radius to apply to each corner of the source image in pixels.

WFCustomMaskImage.label: Custom Image
WFCustomMaskImage.description: An alpha mask to apply to the source image, where darker colors become transparent and lighter colors remain opaque. If the mask is sized differently than the source image, the mask is resized to match the dimensions of the source image.

is.workflow.actions.image.resize.name: Resize Image
is.workflow.actions.image.resize.description: Scales images to a particular width and height.
is.workflow.actions.image.resize.descriptionNote: If the width or height is not set, that dimension is automatically calculated to maintain the original image’s aspect ratio.

is.workflow.actions.image.rotate.name: Rotate Image/Video
is.workflow.actions.image.rotate.description: Turns an image or video clockwise by a particular number of degrees.

WFImgurDirectLink.label: Direct Link
WFImgurDirectLink.description: If enabled, the action will return a link to the image, and not its Imgur page.

WFImgurAlbum.label: Create Album
WFImgurAlbum.description: If enabled, the input images will be grouped into an album. Otherwise, the individual links will be returned.

is.workflow.actions.importaudiofiles.name: Import Audio Files into Music
is.workflow.actions.importaudiofiles.description: Imports audio files into Music and compresses them with the chosen encoder.

is.workflow.actions.input.name: Input
is.workflow.actions.input.description: Stops execution of the current shortcut and dismisses the shortcut on screen. No more actions will be run after this action.

WFInstapaperFolder.label: Folder
WFInstapaperFolder.description: This action will save your input to the specified folder. Leaving this empty will save the input to Instapaper’s Home folder.

is.workflow.actions.instapaper.get.name: Get Instapaper Bookmarks
is.workflow.actions.instapaper.get.description: Gets the contents of a folder in Instapaper. Requires Instapaper Premium.

WFInstapaperFolder.label: Folder
WFInstapaperFolder.description: The folder to get bookmarks from. Leaving this empty will get items from Instapaper’s Home folder.

is.workflow.actions.intercom.name: Intercom
is.workflow.actions.intercom.description: Announces a message passed as input using Intercom.
is.workflow.actions.intercom.descriptionNote: This action accepts both text and media files as input. Media files will be broadcast as they are. When text is provided, it will be first converted to audio using the current Siri language and voice. You can also use the Make Spoken Audio From Text action to customize the voice parameters.

WFInput.label: Message
WFInput.description: The message to announce using Intercom. Any input exceeding 60 seconds in duration will be trimmed.

is.workflow.actions.lightroom.import.name: Import to Lightroom
is.workflow.actions.lightroom.import.description: Imports the photos passed as input into Lightroom.

is.workflow.actions.list.name: List
is.workflow.actions.list.description: Allows you to specify a list of items to be passed to the next action.
is.workflow.actions.list.descriptionNote: If you specify a variable, the contents of that variable will be included in the list.

is.workflow.actions.listeningmode.set.name: Set Noise Control Mode
is.workflow.actions.listeningmode.set.description: Sets a Noise Control mode on your selected device

is.workflow.actions.location.name: Location
is.workflow.actions.location.description: Passes the specified location to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.lock.app.name: Lock App
is.workflow.actions.lock.app.description: Changes whether the selected application is locked. Locked apps require authentication to access.

is.workflow.actions.lockscreen.name: Lock Screen
is.workflow.actions.lockscreen.description: Locks the screen of this device.

is.workflow.actions.lowpowermode.set.name: Set Low Power Mode
is.workflow.actions.lowpowermode.set.description: Sets the device’s Low Power Mode to on or off.

is.workflow.actions.makediskimage.name: Make Disk Image
is.workflow.actions.makediskimage.description: Creates a new disk image (.dmg) file. The disk image will contain any files passed as input.

is.workflow.actions.makegif.name: Make GIF
is.workflow.actions.makegif.description: Creates an animated GIF from the images or video passed into the action.

is.workflow.actions.makeimagefrompdfpage.name: Make Image from PDF Page
is.workflow.actions.makeimagefrompdfpage.description: Creates images from the pages in the PDF passed into the action.

is.workflow.actions.makeimagefromrichtex.name: Make Image from Rich Text
is.workflow.actions.makeimagefromrichtex.description: Creates an image from the rich text, web content, or URL passed in as input.

is.workflow.actions.makepdf.name: Make PDF
is.workflow.actions.makepdf.description: Makes a PDF out of the input. The resulting PDF can optionally include a quarter-inch margin for better printing.

WFPDFDocumentMergeBehavior.label: Merge Behavior
WFPDFDocumentMergeBehavior.description: Merge documents by appending or shuffling pages. Shuffling will add one page from each of the passed documents to the new document, then proceed to take the next page from each passed document, until all pages in the passed documents have been added to the new document.

is.workflow.actions.makespokenaudiofromt.name: Make Spoken Audio from Text
is.workflow.actions.makespokenaudiofromt.description: Creates an audio file from text, using text-to-speech.

is.workflow.actions.makevideofromgif.name: Make Video from GIF
is.workflow.actions.makevideofromgif.description: Converts an animated GIF into a video.

is.workflow.actions.makezip.name: Make Archive
is.workflow.actions.makezip.description: Makes an archive out of the files passed as input. Supports creating zip, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar, gzip, cpio, or iso archives.

is.workflow.actions.math.name: Calculate
is.workflow.actions.math.description: Performs a number operation on the input and returns the result.

is.workflow.actions.measurement.convert.name: Convert Measurement
is.workflow.actions.measurement.convert.description: Converts the measurements passed into the action to the specified unit.

is.workflow.actions.measurement.create.name: Measurement
is.workflow.actions.measurement.create.description: Passes the specified measurement (including number and unit) to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.mountdiskimage.name: Mount Disk Image
is.workflow.actions.mountdiskimage.description: Mounts a disk image (.dmg) file on your desktop.

is.workflow.actions.movewindow.name: Move Window
is.workflow.actions.movewindow.description: Moves one or more windows to the specified location.

Display.label: Display
Display.description: The display to move the window to.

is.workflow.actions.nightshift.set.name: Set Night Shift
is.workflow.actions.nightshift.set.description: Enables or disables Night Shift. When enabled, the colors of your display will be shifted to the warmer end of the color spectrum after dark. This may help you get a better night’s sleep.

is.workflow.actions.nothing.name: Nothing
is.workflow.actions.nothing.description: This action does nothing and produces no output. It is useful to separate blocks of actions, or to explicitly pass an empty input to an action.

is.workflow.actions.number.name: Number
is.workflow.actions.number.description: Passes a number to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.number.random.name: Random Number
is.workflow.actions.number.random.description: Passes a random number between the given minimum and maximum to the next action. The minimum and maximum numbers are included as possible results.

is.workflow.actions.openin.name: Open File
is.workflow.actions.openin.description: Opens the input as a file in the specified app.

is.workflow.actions.openpasswords.name: Search in Passwords
is.workflow.actions.openpasswords.description: Opens Passwords and searches for the given text.

is.workflow.actions.openurl.name: Open URLs
is.workflow.actions.openurl.description: Opens URLs passed into the action in Safari.

is.workflow.actions.openxcallbackurl.name: Open X-Callback URL
is.workflow.actions.openxcallbackurl.description: Performs the specified x-callback-url action. The x-success, x-cancel, and x-error parameters will be added automatically.
is.workflow.actions.openxcallbackurl.descriptionResult: When the app that’s opened calls back to Shortcuts using x-success, it may include parameters in the URL. These will be passed as output to the next action, as text if there is just one parameter, or as a dictionary if there are multiple (use Get Dictionary Value to access it).

WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled.label: Custom Callback
WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled.description: Turn this on if you want to open a callback URL that is not x-callback-url compliant and uses keys other than “x-success”, “x-error”, and “x-cancel”.

WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURLEnabled.label: Custom X-Success URL
WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURLEnabled.description: If enabled, Shortcuts will use a custom success callback URL. This is useful if the app you are calling uses placeholders in the x-success URL to pass output.

WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURL.label: X-Success URL
WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURL.description: For example, you might use shortcuts://callback?result=[[output]]

is.workflow.actions.orientationlock.set.name: Set Orientation Lock
is.workflow.actions.orientationlock.set.description: Turns on or off orientation lock on your device.

is.workflow.actions.output.name: Stop and Output
is.workflow.actions.output.description:
Stops execution of the current shortcut, and outputs content. This action is useful when:
• Running a shortcut from another shortcut (using the Run Shortcut action). The output will be used as the output of the Run Shortcut action.
• Running a shortcut from Quick Actions in Finder on macOS. The output will be saved as a file alongside the files selected in Finder.
• Running a shortcut from Services on macOS. The output will replace the selected text, if applicable.
• Or, when running a shortcut from another location that supports output, like the command-line or the Shortcuts URL scheme.

No more actions will be run after this action.

is.workflow.actions.overlayimageonimage.name: Overlay Image
is.workflow.actions.overlayimageonimage.description: Overlays an image on top of another image.

is.workflow.actions.overlaytext.name: Overlay Text
is.workflow.actions.overlaytext.description: Overlays text onto the image passed as input.

WFTextX.label: X Coordinate
WFTextX.description: The X Coordinate to start the text at, in points. 0 starts at the left of the image.

WFPercentageTextX.label: X Coordinate
WFPercentageTextX.description: The X Coordinate to start the text at, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. 0 starts at the left of the image.

WFTextY.label: Y Coordinate
WFTextY.description: The Y Coordinate to start the text at, in points. 0 starts at the top of the image.

WFPercentageTextY.label: Y Coordinate
WFPercentageTextY.description: The Y Coordinate to start the text at, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. 0 starts at the top of the image.

WFTextOffset.label: Offset
WFTextOffset.description: The amount of additional space between the text box and the nearest edges of the image, in points. For example, the nearest edges are the Left for Middle Left alignment, the Bottom and Right for Bottom Right alignment, and the Top for Top alignment.

WFPercentageTextOffset.label: Offset
WFPercentageTextOffset.description: The amount of additional space between the text box and the nearest edges of the image, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. For example, the nearest edges are the Left for Middle Left alignment, the Bottom and Right for Bottom Right alignment, and the Top for Top alignment.

WFFontSize.label: Font Size
WFFontSize.description: The size of the font, in points, to apply to the text.

WFPercentageFontSize.label: Font Size
WFPercentageFontSize.description: The size of the font, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1, to apply to the text.

WFTextAlignment.label: Text Alignment
WFTextAlignment.description: The alignment to apply to the text. This will align to the edge of the bounding box created by the Maximum Width, if any.

WFTextRotation.label: Rotation
WFTextRotation.description: The amount of rotation, in degrees, to apply to the text. Starts from the center of the text bounds. Optional.

WFTextStrokeWidth.label: Stroke Width
WFTextStrokeWidth.description: The stroke width, in points, to apply to the text. Optional.

WFPercentageTextStrokeWidth.label: Stroke Width
WFPercentageTextStrokeWidth.description: The stroke width, as a decimal proportion of the font size between 0 and 1, to apply to the text. Optional.

WFTextBoxWidth.label: Maximum Width
WFTextBoxWidth.description: The maximum width of the text, in points. If 0, the text will have a bounding box that is as wide as necessary, and may run off the edge of the image. Otherwise, the text will wrap within the bounds of the width. Optional.

WFPercentageTextBoxWidth.label: Maximum Width
WFPercentageTextBoxWidth.description: The maximum width of the text, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. If 0, the text will have a bounding box that is as wide as necessary, and may run off the edge of the image. Otherwise, the text will wrap within the bounds of the width. Optional.

WFSizingMethod.label: Sizing
WFSizingMethod.description: The sizing method to use. Proportional sizing will cause all parameters to use a decimal proportion between 0 and 1. Absolute sizing will cause all parameters to use points.

is.workflow.actions.pausemusic.name: Play/Pause
is.workflow.actions.pausemusic.description: Plays or pauses the currently playing media.

is.workflow.actions.personalhotspot.pass.name: Get Hotspot Password
is.workflow.actions.personalhotspot.pass.description: Returns the password of your Personal Hotspot.

is.workflow.actions.personalhotspot.set.name: Set Personal Hotspot
is.workflow.actions.personalhotspot.set.description: Sets the device’s Personal Hotspot to on or off.
is.workflow.actions.personalhotspot.set.descriptionNote: When turning Personal Hotspot on, this action will make the hotspot discoverable for only a short period of time, in order to preserve battery life.

is.workflow.actions.phonenumber.name: Phone Number
is.workflow.actions.phonenumber.description: Passes the specified phone numbers to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.photos.createalbum.name: Create Photo Album
is.workflow.actions.photos.createalbum.description: Creates a new album in the Photos app, including the specified photos and videos.
is.workflow.actions.photos.createalbum.descriptionResult: The items saved to the album

AlbumName.label: Album Name
AlbumName.description: If there is already a photo album by this name, photos will be added to the existing album instead of creating a new one.

is.workflow.actions.pinboard.add.name: Add to Pinboard
is.workflow.actions.pinboard.add.description: Adds the URL passed into the action to your Pinboard.

is.workflow.actions.pinboard.get.name: Get Pinboard Bookmarks
is.workflow.actions.pinboard.get.description: Gets bookmarks in your Pinboard account.

WFPinTags.label: Tags
WFPinTags.description: If specified, only items matching all of these tags will be returned. Supports a maximum of three tags.

is.workflow.actions.playmusic.name: Play Music
is.workflow.actions.playmusic.description: Plays music using the Music app.

is.workflow.actions.playpodcast.name: Play Podcast
is.workflow.actions.playpodcast.description: Plays a podcast using the Podcasts app. If no podcast is selected, resumes playback.

WFPodcastPlaybackOrder.label: Playback Order
WFPodcastPlaybackOrder.description: The order within a show of the episodes to play. By default, the order will match the order used in the Podcasts app.

is.workflow.actions.playsound.name: Play Sound
is.workflow.actions.playsound.description: Plays the audio file passed as input, or a default notification sound if no audio file was passed.

WFPocketTags.label: Tags
WFPocketTags.description: A comma-separated list of tags to apply to the items added to Pocket.

is.workflow.actions.pocket.get.name: Get Items from Pocket
is.workflow.actions.pocket.get.description: Returns items in your Pocket account.

WFPocketItemSearchTerm.label: Search
WFPocketItemSearchTerm.description: If specified, only items with titles or URLs matching this search will be returned.

WFPocketItemSearchTags.label: Tag
WFPocketItemSearchTags.description: If specified, only items matching this tag will be returned.

is.workflow.actions.podcasts.subscribe.name: Follow Podcast
is.workflow.actions.podcasts.subscribe.description: Follows podcasts or podcast feed URLs passed into the action.

is.workflow.actions.posters.get.name: Get All Wallpapers
is.workflow.actions.posters.get.description: Gets all of your Lock Screen wallpapers, and returns them as output so you can use them with other actions.

is.workflow.actions.posters.switch.name: Switch Between Wallpapers
is.workflow.actions.posters.switch.description: Switches the current Lock Screen wallpaper.
is.workflow.actions.posters.switch.descriptionNote: If the wallpaper has a linked Focus, this action will set the Focus, too.

is.workflow.actions.previewdocument.name: Quick Look
is.workflow.actions.previewdocument.description: Displays a preview of the input using the system Quick Look.

is.workflow.actions.properties.appstore.name: Get Details of App Store App

is.workflow.actions.properties.safariweb.name: Get Details of Safari Web Page
is.workflow.actions.properties.safariweb.descriptionNote: Safari Web Page items are only available when running your shortcut as an Action Extension in Safari.

is.workflow.actions.quit.app.name: Quit App
is.workflow.actions.quit.app.description: Quits one or all open applications. You can choose a list of apps to keep open.

is.workflow.actions.readinglist.name: Add to Reading List
is.workflow.actions.readinglist.description: Adds URLs passed into the action to your reading list.

is.workflow.actions.reboot.name: Shut Down
is.workflow.actions.reboot.description: Shuts down or restarts your device.

is.workflow.actions.recordaudio.name: Record Audio
is.workflow.actions.recordaudio.description: Uses the microphone to record audio.

WFRecordingCompression.label: Audio Quality
WFRecordingCompression.description: High-quality audio takes up a lot more space than normal audio, so stick with normal unless you really need it. Normal audio is returned as an M4A file (with AAC audio), while high-quality audio is returned in uncompressed WAV format.

is.workflow.actions.reminders.showlist.name: Open Reminders List
is.workflow.actions.reminders.showlist.description: Shows the specified list in the Reminders app.

is.workflow.actions.removeevents.name: Remove Events
is.workflow.actions.removeevents.description: Removes all events passed into the action from the calendars they are contained in.
is.workflow.actions.removeevents.descriptionNote: This is a destructive and permanent action. You will be asked to confirm before events are removed.

WFCalendarIncludeFutureEvents.label: Include Future Events
WFCalendarIncludeFutureEvents.description: When enabled, any repeats of an event in the future are also removed.

is.workflow.actions.removefromalbum.name: Remove from Photo Album
is.workflow.actions.removefromalbum.description: Removes the photos or videos passed as input from the specified photo album.

is.workflow.actions.removereminders.name: Remove Reminders
is.workflow.actions.removereminders.description: Removes all reminders passed into the action from the lists they are contained in.
is.workflow.actions.removereminders.descriptionNote: This is a destructive and permanent action. You will be asked to confirm before reminders are removed.

is.workflow.actions.repeat.count.name: Repeat
is.workflow.actions.repeat.count.description: Repeats the contained actions, running them the specified number of times.

is.workflow.actions.repeat.each.name: Repeat with Each
is.workflow.actions.repeat.each.description: Takes a list of items as input, and runs the contained actions once for each item in the list.
is.workflow.actions.repeat.each.descriptionResult: Every item passed to the “End Repeat” action

is.workflow.actions.resizewindow.name: Resize Window
is.workflow.actions.resizewindow.description: Resizes one or more windows to the specified width and height.

is.workflow.actions.ride.requestride.name: Request Ride
is.workflow.actions.ride.requestride.description: Requests a ride from the specified pickup location to a specified drop off location.

is.workflow.actions.round.name: Round Number
is.workflow.actions.round.description: Rounds the number(s) passed into the action.

is.workflow.actions.rss.name: Get Items from RSS Feed
is.workflow.actions.rss.description: Downloads the latest items from an RSS feed.

is.workflow.actions.rss.extract.name: Get RSS Feeds from Page
is.workflow.actions.rss.extract.description: Extracts any RSS feed URLs from the given web URLs or web page.

Script.default:
on run {input, parameters}
    (* Your script goes here *)
    return input
end run

is.workflow.actions.runextension.name: Share with Apps
is.workflow.actions.runextension.description: Prompts to share the specified content using action extensions and sharing extensions provided by other apps.

is.workflow.actions.runjavascriptforauto.name: Run JavaScript for Mac Automation
is.workflow.actions.runjavascriptforauto.description: This action executes a JavaScript for Automation (JXA) script.

is.workflow.actions.runjavascriptonwebpa.name: Run JavaScript on Active Safari Tab
is.workflow.actions.runjavascriptonwebpa.description: Runs JavaScript on a Safari web page passed in as input
is.workflow.actions.runjavascriptonwebpa.descriptionNote: Safari Web Page items are only available when running your shortcut as an Action Extension in Safari.

WFJavaScript.label: JavaScript

is.workflow.actions.runshellscript.name: Run Shell Script
is.workflow.actions.runshellscript.description: This action executes a UNIX shell script. The script will execute starting in your user’s home directory.

Shell.label: Shell
Shell.description: The shell to use for interpreting and running the script.

InputMode.label: Pass Input
InputMode.description: to stdin: The input will be converted to a file and directed to the stdin pipe of the script.\nas arguments: The input will be converted to a list of strings and passed as arguments to the script.

RunAsRoot.label: Run as Administrator
RunAsRoot.description: When enabled, Shortcuts will ask for an administrator’s password and run the script as the root user. This is similar to using sudo on the command line.

is.workflow.actions.runsshscript.name: Run Script Over SSH
is.workflow.actions.runsshscript.description: Runs a script on a remote computer over SSH.
is.workflow.actions.runsshscript.descriptionResult: The output from the shell script (stdout)

is.workflow.actions.runworkflow.name: Run Shortcut
is.workflow.actions.runworkflow.description: Runs a shortcut from your shortcut.

is.workflow.actions.safari.geturl.name: Get Current Web Page from Safari
is.workflow.actions.safari.geturl.description: Gets the web page of the frontmost Safari window.
is.workflow.actions.safari.geturl.summary: Get current web page from Safari

is.workflow.actions.savetocameraroll.name: Save to Photos
is.workflow.actions.savetocameraroll.description: Adds the photos and videos passed as input to the specified photo album.
is.workflow.actions.savetocameraroll.descriptionNote: If a photo passed as input is already in the specified album, the photo will be duplicated.

is.workflow.actions.searchappstore.name: Find App Store Apps
is.workflow.actions.searchappstore.description: Searches the App Store, returning the apps that match the specified search terms. You can get more details about the results using the Get Details of App Store App action.

is.workflow.actions.searchitunes.name: Find iTunes Store Items
is.workflow.actions.searchitunes.description: Searches the iTunes Store, returning the items that match the specified search terms. You can get more details about the results using the Get Details of iTunes Product action.

is.workflow.actions.searchlocalbusinesse.name: Find Places
is.workflow.actions.searchlocalbusinesse.description: Finds nearby places using Maps, and returns the results.

WFSearchQuery.label: Search
WFSearchQuery.description: Keywords used to search for places.

WFSearchRadius.label: Radius
WFSearchRadius.description: Radius of search area around the reference location.

WFSearchSortOrder.label: Sort By
WFSearchSortOrder.description: How to order the search results - by relevance, or by distance from the reference location.

is.workflow.actions.searchmaps.name: Open in Maps
is.workflow.actions.searchmaps.description: Opens your choice of Maps, Google Maps, or Waze and searches for the location, place, or text that was passed into the action.

is.workflow.actions.searchpodcasts.name: Find Podcasts
is.workflow.actions.searchpodcasts.description: Finds podcasts in the Apple Podcasts catalog, returning the items that match the specified search terms.

is.workflow.actions.searchweb.name: Search Web
is.workflow.actions.searchweb.description: Searches the web for the text provided as input.

is.workflow.actions.seek.name: Seek
is.workflow.actions.seek.description: Seek to a specific time, or forward and backward by some duration, in the currently playing media.

is.workflow.actions.selectcontacts.name: Select Contact
is.workflow.actions.selectcontacts.description: Prompts to pick a person from your contacts and passes the selection to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.selectemail.name: Select Email Address
is.workflow.actions.selectemail.description: Prompts to pick an email address from your contacts and passes the selection to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.selectphone.name: Select Phone Number
is.workflow.actions.selectphone.description: Prompts to pick a phone number from your contacts and passes the selection to the next action.

is.workflow.actions.selectphoto.name: Select Photos
is.workflow.actions.selectphoto.description: Prompts to choose photos and videos from your photo library.

is.workflow.actions.sendemail.name: Send Email
is.workflow.actions.sendemail.description: Pass text into the action to set the email body. Other types of input are added as attachments.

WFSendEmailActionFrom.label: From
WFSendEmailActionFrom.description: The email address to send from. This must be an email address that is set up in the Mail app.

is.workflow.actions.sendmessage.name: Send Message
is.workflow.actions.sendmessage.description: Sends a message. Pass images, videos, or other files as input to include attachments.

WFBrightness.label: Brightness
WFBrightness.description: If you set the brightness using a variable, use a number between 0 and 1 (for example, pass 0.5 for half brightness).

is.workflow.actions.setclipboard.name: Copy to Clipboard
is.workflow.actions.setclipboard.description: Copies the result of the last action to the clipboard.

WFLocalOnly.label: Local Only
WFLocalOnly.description: When enabled, the input will only be copied locally, and will not be shared to other devices via Handoff.

WFExpirationDate.label: Expire At
WFExpirationDate.description: When set, the clipboard contents will expire and be automatically deleted at the specified time. Optional.

is.workflow.actions.setitemname.name: Set Name
is.workflow.actions.setitemname.description: Sets the name of the item passed as input.

WFDontIncludeFileExtension.label: Don’t Include File Extension
WFDontIncludeFileExtension.description: By default, Shortcuts will automatically include a file extension if one isn’t specified. Turn this on if you want to create a file with no extension.

is.workflow.actions.setparkedcar.name: Set Parked Car
is.workflow.actions.setparkedcar.description: Saves details of your Parked Car in the Maps app.
is.workflow.actions.setparkedcar.descriptionResult: The location of the car and its associated details, if any.

WFSetParkedCarNotes.label: Notes
WFSetParkedCarNotes.description: Optional text that will be stored along with your parked car.

WFImage.label: Image
WFImage.description: An optional image of the location where you parked the car.

is.workflow.actions.setplaybackdestinati.name: Change Playback Destination
is.workflow.actions.setplaybackdestinati.description: Changes the current playback destination. Use this action to route audio to AirPods, Bluetooth speakers, HomePod, or other AirPlay devices.
